Results.ReviewText: We had moved into a smaller home several years ago, and I decided to buy an electric grill, and it worked OK, except when it gets cold in Nebraska. So far I am very happy with the Weber grill, I had given my old Weber grill to my son, and he is still using it, and it is probably 20 years old.

Results.ReviewText: I’ve only had it a short while, but I really like the cooking performance compared to the Spirit II I previously had.  I soulless you see a couple of design improvements however:  I’d like to be able to hang the propane tank on the outside in order to maximize storage underneath.  And I prefer one set of larger wheels and two stationary legs rather than the four rather flimsy casters.  That would improve its portability.
Results.Title: Nice Grill, but could use some design improvement.

Results.ReviewText: After a month of use, haven't found anything that would suggest, I won't be happy over the long term

Results.ReviewText: I had a weber grill that lasted over 25 years with some refurbishing along the way. This year I decided it was time for a new grill even though my old one was still working. So far my new grill has met all my expectations and I am glad I purchased it. The stainless steel shelves are a little high maintenance compared to the old plastic ones. I purchased some stainless steel polish that is working well.
Results.Title: Satisfied Customer

Results.ReviewText: Avec mon Weber qui diffuse sa chaleur avec une stabilité partout sur la surface de cuisson, c'est tellement plus facile de bien réussir mes viandes à la perfection.

46510001.Name: Spirit E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
46510001.Description:
Add flavor to the menu with a Spirit E-310. It’s the ideal grill for entertaining a small crowd or a perfect solution to any family meal. Place serving trays and spices on the side tables so that everything you need is where you are, when you need it. With features such as porcelain-enameled, cast-iron cooking grates that retain even heat, you’re guaranteed the best tasting food. It’s built to last with a cookbox that helps prevent rusting and peeling, and conveniently equipped with six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools. If that wasn’t enough, the low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system takes the hassle out of cooking.


• Durable, easy-to-clean porcelain-enamel cast iron grates.

• Porcelain-enameled finish helps prevent rusting and pealing.

• Six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools.

• Low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system.

• 424 square inches of main grilling space.


 This product requires assembly.
